verdictVocabulary.pass: meets the rule as rendered, no caveats
verdictVocabulary.fixable: misses the rule but the fix is known and cheap -- note MUST say what
verdictVocabulary.fail: misses the rule, ships broken if unaddressed
verdictVocabulary.unreviewed: not yet judged by a human or fresh-context agent -- the template default

items.rule: Pure-black #000000 text; white background; box fills white or none -- no soft-black/gray body text.
items.note: Text is #000000 throughout; canvas is #ffffff. Contribution boxes carry a light sand fill #f3efe6 (USER-SET 2026-07-19, lum 0.865 > the 0.55 dark-fill floor); all other boxes are #ffffff. No gray body text.

items.rule: <=2 non-gray hue families, each hue encodes exactly one declared meaning; colour only on borders/arrows/icons/data, zero decorative tint.
items.note: One tint + two border hues, each encoding one declared meaning. Sand #f3efe6 fill = this thesis's contribution vs the MODQN baseline (a single tint for a single meaning — academic.md rule 2's sanctioned light tint). Borders: navy #2f5d80 = main agent / deployment path, ochre #8a5740 = catfish roles and training-only mechanisms. No decorative colour; the meaning is stated in the caption.

items.rule: No gradient/shadow/glow/3D/clip-art/photo texture; corner radius <= ~5% of box height.
items.note: Flat rects, rx=3 against h=78/106 (<5%); no gradient, shadow, glow, 3D or clip-art.

items.rule: Exactly 1-2 stroke weights (normal ~1.5pt, emphasis ~2.5pt); emphasis = the thicker stroke, never a dark fill.
items.note: Two weights only: 1.5px normal, 2.5px emphasis. Emphasis is the thicker border, never a dark fill.

items.rule: One serif family (Times New Roman) matching the paper body, <=2 sizes, math variables italic, Unicode operators not ASCII ->/<=.
items.note: Times New Roman only; two sizes (24 node / 22 edge, section, annotation); variables italic via autoNotation; Unicode operators only.

items.rule: Small line-style icons only where they carry meaning; at most one signature glyph per project, confined to the boxes it names.
items.note: No icons or glyphs in this figure.

items.rule: Whitespace lives between semantic groups, not inside boxes; a panel more than 1/3 empty must shrink or grow.
items.note: Whitespace sits between semantic groups, not inside boxes.

items.rule: Self-evident left-to-right spine (or row-major fold with an explicit wrap line); dashed = hypothesis/side-context declared in a legend; frameless labels; no in-figure title.
items.note: Self-evident spine; dashed frame = training-only. No footer prose (academic.md rule 9): frame / fill / dashed meaning lives in the thesis caption.

items.rule: Whole-canvas balance at print scale: no dead zones / empty regions left once every box individually passes rule 7.
items.note: Checked at print scale on the raster; no dead region large enough to read as an unfinished panel.

items.rule: At a glance the eye actually follows the intended flow -- the holistic read, not just the structural self-evidence rule 8 encodes.
items.note: The eye follows the spine as intended; verified on the raster, not the spec.

items.rule: Every edge label is unambiguous about which arrow it names -- no near-miss with a neighboring edge or label.
items.note: Every edge label sits on the straight run of the edge it names, clear of neighbouring edges and of every box border.

items.rule: Every semantic distinction (hue-encoded meaning, dashed-vs-solid, emphasis stroke) still reads once the figure is converted to grayscale.
items.note: Verified on the grayscale twin: solid-vs-dashed frames and the 2.5px emphasis stroke survive. The sand fill is subtle in grayscale by design — it is REDUNDANT encoding (border hue + the caption also state contribution), so no information is lost in black-and-white print.
